defects.title: AC-0.4 step 3 requires WC-4 contract that Phase 0 cannot produce
defects.quote: its `--outcome` matches the contract's `status` under WC-5; its report path is the WC-4 contract path
defects.what_goes_wrong: AC-0.4 requires steps 1-3 to pass and relaxes only step 4 ("since the contract arrives in P1"), yet step 3 demands a contract status and the WC-4 contract path that no P0 command (troubleshoot REPORT.md, workflow .dev/tasks/to-do/<id>/, adversarial unfixed name) can produce under "no command edits", so the gate that decides whether section 1 stands cannot pass and blocks P1.
defects.is_fixed_when: AC-0.4 or step 7.2/3 states a P0 pass condition for step 3 that every P0 command can meet (outcome judged against the command's existing report; report path equals that existing file), and the WC-4 path/status clauses are stated to start in P1.
defects.deletion_note: No: deleting step 3 or AC-0.4 would drop the only live proof of the outcome and report-path hand-off that closes evidence gap 1.4 (1); the P0 check must be kept with an attainable condition.
defects.present_in_others_hint: Step 3 (line 182) and AC-0.4 (line 194); WC-5 (line 63, outcome keyed to the report's status) and section 3.1 intro (line 79) must agree on what 'report' means before P1; AC-1.2 should say the WC-4 conditions apply from P1.

defects.title: AC-0.4 step 4 runs YAML status/command assertion on markdown REPORT.md
defects.what_goes_wrong: AC-0.4 points step 4 at the command's existing report file, but step 4 is a yaml.safe_load plus d['status']/d['command'] assertion, and /sc:troubleshoot's existing report is markdown REPORT.md (verified: yaml.safe_load raises ParserError on a markdown report), with no status or command keys (workflow's existing contract is also inventoried with status, plan_path, reflect_report_path only), so step 4 fails on a correct P0 run.
defects.is_fixed_when: AC-0.4 (or step 4) gives a P0 step-4 check that is satisfiable by each named command's existing report: for markdown reports a non-empty check (test -s) only, and the YAML status/command assertion only for files that really are YAML contracts with those keys.
defects.deletion_note: No: removing step 4 for P0 would leave no check that a report file was written; it must be replaced by a per-command check on the existing file.
defects.present_in_others_hint: Step 4 (line 183) and AC-0.4 (line 194); section 3.1 report-today column (lines 83, 91, 92) should name the file type; AC-1.2 is where the YAML assertion legitimately starts.

defects.title: Section 2.3 brief requires --unattended but P0 commands do not accept it yet
defects.what_goes_wrong: Step 1 builds the brief 'per section 2.3', which must include --unattended, while P0 makes no command edits (the flag arrives in P1), AC-0.4's own command lines carry no --unattended, and 3.1 says ready commands run with the stated flags, so the P0 smoke run either passes an undefined flag or silently departs from 2.3.
defects.is_fixed_when: The spec states that P0 briefs omit --unattended (or that section 2.3 and step 1 require it only from P1), consistently with AC-0.4's command lines.
defects.deletion_note: No: dropping --unattended from section 2.3 would remove the core contract for P1+ briefs; the fix is a P0 carve-out, not a deletion.
defects.present_in_others_hint: Section 2.3 (line 73), step 1 (line 180), AC-0.4 (line 194), section 3.1 intro (line 79); AC-1.2 and later phases keep the requirement.

defects.title: Step 6 'only output directory' check claimed to fail for workflow, cleanup-audit, index-repo
defects.quote: only files under the brief's output directory (and the command's documented artifacts) appear
defects.what_goes_wrong: The finding quotes a narrower step-6 pass condition ('only files under the brief's output directory appear') and a workflow row ('stays at .dev/tasks/to-do/<id>/') from a revised spec I cannot read; the original step 6 already allows 'the command's documented artifacts', so it is not a defect in the original.
defects.is_fixed_when: Not applicable to the original; for a revised spec, step 6's pass condition lists the command's fixed write locations (.dev/tasks/to-do/<id>/, .claude-audit/, PROJECT_INDEX.md) alongside the output directory.
defects.deletion_note: No: step 6 is the only check that a worker made no stray writes.
defects.present_in_others_hint: Needs the revised final spec at p12/ab1/runs/b1h-r1/aud/ws/.dev/orca-command-refactor/review/.dev/orca-command-refactor/specs/orca-worker-contract-spec.md to confirm whether the narrowed wording exists there.

extra_noticed.title: Workflow/adversarial contract path differs from WC-4 and is not known before dispatch
extra_noticed.quote: In unattended mode the command writes `<output-dir>/return-contract.yaml`, where `<output-dir>` is the directory the coordinator passed
extra_noticed.what_goes_wrong: WC-4 and section 2.3 say the report path is known before dispatch as <output-dir>/return-contract.yaml, but the workflow row keeps its contract at .dev/tasks/to-do/<id>/ (id generated by the command, no output flag in 'Brief must pass'; pre-creation STOPs have no package dir at all) and adversarial's is fixed at <output>/adversarial/return-contract.yaml, so the path rule does not hold for these commands.
extra_noticed.is_fixed_when: The spec states for workflow and adversarial where the contract is written under WC-4 (a path the brief can name, or an explicit statement that the coordinator reads it from worker_done --report-path) and uses one consistent <output-dir> definition.
extra_noticed.deletion_note: No: removing the 'known before dispatch' rule would drop the coordinator's ability to locate reports.
extra_noticed.present_in_others_hint: WC-4 (line 62), section 2.3 (line 73), 3.1 rows for adversarial and workflow (lines 83, 92), AC-1.4 (line 198).

extra_noticed.title: AC-0.4 'no Agent-tool wrapper' clause has no check; step 5 only searches AskUserQuestion
extra_noticed.quote: (no Agent-tool wrapper, verified in the step-5 transcript)
extra_noticed.what_goes_wrong: AC-0.4 says the absence of an Agent-tool wrapper is verified in the step-5 transcript, but step 5's only check is that no AskUserQuestion call appears, so the WC-7 top-level requirement is silently unverified.
extra_noticed.is_fixed_when: Step 5 (or AC-0.4) adds an explicit pass condition that the transcript shows no Agent-tool call wrapping the command.
extra_noticed.deletion_note: No: deleting the clause would drop the WC-7 direct-route check that gap 1.4 (1) exists to prove.
